title: RelayCaching: Accelerating LLM Collaboration via Decoding KV Cache Reuse
authors: Yingsheng Geng; Yuchong Gao; Weihong Wu; Guyue Liu; Jiang Liu
affiliations: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, Tsinghua University, University of Electronic Science and Technology of China, Peking University
research_focus: LLM serving, Agentic / Workflow serving, Long-context / Prefix cache

problem_statement.en: Multi-agent LLM pipelines suffer cascading redundant prefill: each agent's output is embedded into downstream prompts, but prefix variation means the same tokens appear under different preceding contexts, so serving systems recompute KV caches from scratch, with prefill cost growing quadratically (O(M^2)) in interaction turns. Prefix caching fails on non-prefix positions and pre-computed caching assumes static offline content.
problem_statement.zh: 多 agent LLM pipeline 存在串聯式冗餘 prefill：每個 agent 的輸出會嵌入下游 prompt，但由於 prefix variation，相同 token 出現在不同前文之下，服務系統必須重新計算 KV cache，prefill 成本隨互動輪數呈二次成長（O(M^2)）。Prefix caching 在非前綴位置失效，而預先計算式 caching 假設內容為靜態離線，皆不適用於動態多 agent 情境。

key_innovation.en: Training-free decode-to-prefill KV reuse: directly reuse upstream agents' decoding-phase KV caches (with RoPE re-applied for position alignment) in downstream prefill, plus selective rectification guided by an offline layer-range profiler that exploits the U-shaped layer-wise value-cosine similarity profile to pick a critical layer range and detection layer, and a token selector combining deviation-based and influence-based (attention-derived, suffix-aware) criteria.
key_innovation.zh: 免訓練的 decode-to-prefill KV 重用：將上游 agent 於 decoding 階段產生的 KV cache（重新套用 RoPE 對齊位置）直接用於下游 prefill，並施以選擇性修正——離線 layer-range profiler 利用逐層 value cosine 相似度的 U 形分布界定關鍵層區間與偵測層，token selector 結合偏差式與影響力式（attention 累積、字尾感知）準則挑選需重算的 token。

baselines_compared: Full Prefill, Direct Reuse (zero rectification), CacheBlend, EPIC, KVComm

key_improvements.en: Over 80% KV cache reuse with accuracy comparable to full prefill; TTFT reduced by up to 4.7x versus the standard pipeline; sub-linear TTFT scaling with context length (9.2x speedup over full prefill and 2.5x over CacheBlend at 12k cumulative output tokens).
key_improvements.zh: KV cache 重用率逾 80% 且準確率與 full prefill 相當；TTFT 相較標準 pipeline 最高降低 4.7 倍；TTFT 隨 context 長度呈次線性成長（累積輸出 12k token 時較 full prefill 加速 9.2 倍、較 CacheBlend 加速 2.5 倍）。

ai_task: Multi-agent Systems, LLM Serving, AI Inference KV Cache transfer
